-- If the function is Lipschitz then it is continuous:
theorem Lipschitz_continuous (f : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (Lpos : L > 0) (isLip : isLipschitz f L) : isContinuous f := by
  unfold isContinuous
  intros x eps epsPos
  let delt := eps / L
  exists delt
  have deltPos: delt > 0 := by
    unfold delt
    field_simp [div_pos, *]
    simp [*]
  have main: ∀ (y : ℝ), |x - y| < delt → |f x - f y| < eps := by

theorem Lipschitz_continuous (f : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (Lpos : L > 0) (isLip : isLipschitz f L) : isContinuous f := by
  unfold isContinuous
  intros x eps epsPos
